title: At the Corner of Quantum and Gravity
summary: In the presence of spacetime boundaries, diffeomorphisms in gravitational theories can become physical and acquire non-vanishing Noether charges. These charges obey an algebra which, within the extended phase-space formalism, faithfully realizes diffeomorphism algebra. The corner proposal takes this algebra of physical corner symmetries as a fundamental ingredient of quantum gravity, in close analogy with the role of the Poincaré group in quantum field theory.
